achievements.name: Core Breach
achievements.description: Enter the Prismacore, found deep within the Grey Labyrinth.

achievements.name: Fly like a Bea
achievements.description: Fly for 5 seconds using the jetpack.

achievements.name: Tinker Tailor Science Slime
achievements.description: Craft 8 unique player upgrades.

achievements.name: Complete Conservatory
achievements.description: Purchase 5 Ranch Expansions.

achievements.name: A Real Hero
achievements.description: Complete the game's endgame content: light the towers and ring the bells scattered across the map to activate the path to the Prismacore, then win the final boss fight there to help Gigi stabilize it and save Rainbow Island.

achievements.name: Tinkerer
achievements.description: Place your first gadget.

achievements.name: Now You're Thinking With Plortals
achievements.description: Fire a plort through a linked cannon, sending it to the plort market.

achievements.name: Beam Me Up
achievements.description: Craft and use a Return Home Portal.

achievements.name: Shady Deals
achievements.description: Make 3 purchases at the Night Market, a special vendor that only appears at a specific location around midnight.

achievements.name: Charged Up
achievements.description: Get hit by a bolt of lightning.

achievements.name: Polestar Pro
achievements.description: Purchase 40 items in the Polestar Provisions shop.

achievements.name: All That Glitters
achievements.description: Have a Strange Diamond, Sun Sap, Royal Jelly, and Lightning Mote in your vac at the same time.

achievements.name: Rainbow Explorer
achievements.description: Discover any three areas.

achievements.name: Can't Make an Omelette
achievements.description: Break a Yolky Slime egg.

achievements.name: Secret Behind the Waterfall
achievements.description: Discover the entrance to Powderfall Bluffs, a hidden, frosty biome.

achievements.name: Into the Unknown
achievements.description: Open one of the large sealed doors leading into the Grey Labyrinth.

achievements.name: Plortonomics
achievements.description: Sell 15 different types of plorts.

achievements.name: Treasure Hunter
achievements.description: Loot 50 treasure pods.

achievements.name: Far Range Friends
achievements.description: Use the Comm Station to receive a gift from Mochi, Viktor, Thora, Ogden, and BOb.

achievements.name: Quantum Crafter
achievements.description: Craft 5 Quantum Drones.

achievements.name: Pop!
achievements.description: Feed 3 Gordos to bursting.

achievements.name: Turn the Dial
achievements.description: Fill 10 Shadow Plort Collectors while exploring the Grey Labyrinth.

achievements.name: Bea-llionaire
achievements.description: Earn 100000 newbucks from selling plorts.

achievements.name: A Real Goal-Getter
achievements.description: Get a score of 120 on a Slimeball goal gadget within 1 minute.

achievements.name: Tarrnado
achievements.description: Shoot a tarr into a tornado.

achievements.name: Rainbow Researcher
achievements.description: Complete the Slimepedia.

achievements.name: You Can Pet the Cat
achievements.description: At the ProntoMart shop terminal, click the small cat icon on screen.
